title: Thank You, SPIE!
body:
Thank you SPIE, the international society for optics and photonics!
We had a great time at Photonics West this year, and we hope to be back!
body_ko:
SPIE, the international society for optics and photonics에 감사드립니다!
올해 Photonics West에서 멋진 시간을 보냈고, 다시 함께하기를 바랍니다!
excerpt: Thank you SPIE, the international society for optics and photonics!
excerpt_ko: SPIE, the international society for optics and photonics에 감사드립니다!
